skill_name: Trace the evolution of the Internet
workflow: The evolution of the Internet began in the late 1960s with the development of ARPANET, the precursor to the modern-day Internet. This early version of the Internet was used primarily by the US military, universities, and corporations to share resources and information. It wasn’t until the late 1980s that the Internet was made available to the public, and the early 1990s saw a massive expansion of connectivity and access. This period gave rise to a number of new technologies, including email, FTP
